line: That nigga said fuck me, his bitch like me and he broker than me
vault_lines: That nigga said fuck me, his bitch like me and he broker than me

meaning: Uzi is using his infamous original “Eternal Atake” cover as a sexual innuendo. When Uzi originally announced his next project would be called “Eternal Atake” he also shared artwork that was reminiscent of the cult Heaven’s Gate. Uzi garnered a lot of backlash for the use of this cover and eventually changed it.
